Friends, today we will talk about upcoming expressway mega-projects in India that we will see in the coming years. Also, some of the expressways that are soon to be completed. This list includes several expressways that are under construction, some of which have already been approved by the BS and some whose DPRs are ready.
World class Expressways In INDIA
